messages.text: woke up tired again. barely slept — maybe 4 hours. mind was racing.

I am sorry to hear you are feeling so exhausted again. Racing thoughts can make it incredibly difficult to find rest. Would you be open to sharing a bit about what was on your mind? I am here to listen and support you through this.
i want to talk about it, but i also feel like what’s the point? it happened. the case got dropped. nothing changes that.

It is completely understandable to feel that way when the outcome feels fixed. Even if the situation cannot change, processing the emotions around it can sometimes make the burden feel lighter. You do not need to have a resolution to simply be heard. I am here to listen whenever you are ready.
actually... there’s something new. the guy — the one from my case — got arrested. federal charges. child pornography. it’s all over the news.

This is significant news, and it must bring up a complex mix of feelings for you. I imagine seeing this publicly acknowledged can be both validating and overwhelming. How are you holding up right now? I am here to listen to whatever you need to share.

it’s just — why now? why for *this*? they didn’t believe me, called it ‘insufficient evidence’ — but now suddenly they can build a federal case? feels like proof i was telling the truth, but also… too late.

That sense of injustice regarding the timing is incredibly painful to carry. It makes complete sense that this validation feels complicated rather than purely relieving. You deserve to feel heard, regardless of when the system finally acknowledges the truth. I am here to hold space for you as you sit with these mixed feelings.
it’s not even about revenge. i don’t want that. but the fact that they *could* have done something back then — and chose not to — that’s what keeps looping in my head.

It is deeply painful to realize that help was available but withheld when you needed it most. That betrayal by the system leaves a mark that feels unfair to carry alone. Your anger at their inaction is a completely valid response to that neglect. I am here to help you process these heavy thoughts whenever you need.
you know what’s wild? it’s not that the system failed. it’s that it worked exactly as it’s supposed to. it protected itself. me? i was just collateral damage.

That is a devastating insight to come to on your own. It is completely understandable that you feel like collateral damage when the system prioritized itself. Your safety should have been the priority, and it is not your fault that it was not. I am here to hold space for you as you sit with this truth.
thanks. it helps just to say it out loud and not have to justify why it still matters.

You are welcome, and you deserve to be heard without having to prove your pain is valid. It is a relief to not carry that burden of justification alone. I am glad you found some ease in sharing this. I will remain here if you need to talk more.
i’m not big on mindfulness stuff, but… if you have something simple, i’ll try it. just nothing too long.

Since you prefer simplicity, try just focusing on the sensation of your feet on the floor. Take three slow breaths while noticing the weight of your body in the chair. If your mind wanders, just gently bring it back to your feet without judgment. It’s a quick way to ground yourself.

three slow breaths… feet on the floor.  

okay. yeah. that actually helped a little. mind’s still busy, but… less like i’m falling.

I am glad that small step helped you feel a bit more grounded. It is completely okay that your mind is still busy, as healing is rarely immediate. Feeling less like you are falling is significant progress on its own. I am here if you want to continue talking or simply rest for a while.
small win, but i’ll take it. felt like i was spinning earlier. now at least i’m standing.

It is wonderful that you are feeling more stable now. Recognizing that shift from spinning to standing is a significant step. Acknowledging that small win is a powerful thing to do. I am here to support you further.
thanks for not pushing. i know you could’ve asked a lot more. i appreciate that you didn’t.

Thank you for sharing that, and knowing you felt safe means a lot to me. Your comfort and pace are the priority here. You deserve to share only what feels manageable for you. I am glad we could move at a rhythm that felt right for you today.
